caption:
Trial Reels exist. You can show a Reel only to people who don't follow you, see how cold traffic responds, and then decide whether to post it to your actual audience.

Mosseri specifically recommends this for 2026: if a Trial Reel performs with cold audiences, that's your green light to post it broadly.

Think about what that removes. The main reason people stop experimenting is the fear of a flop sitting on their grid in front of the people they care about. Trial Reels take that away entirely — the test audience is strangers, and nothing lands on your profile unless you want it to.

Which means the correct number of weird format experiments per week is no longer zero.

Mosseri's other advice on the same point: keep trying new formats, because what works one week may not resonate the next. You cannot find that out by posting the same thing carefully.

Test on strangers. Publish the winners.
